in_marathi.name: Subhajit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Good, auspicious, propitious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Subhajit is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'subha' meaning good and 'jit' meaning victorious. It signifies a good and auspicious victory. In Bengali, it means good and prosperous.
